name: United Arab Emirates
description: The United Arab Emirates from ancient Magan and the pearl coast to the Trucial States, the union of 1971, oil and the towers of Dubai.

checkpoints.name: The pearl coast
checkpoints.note: Copper from Magan was traded with Sumer. Later the coast lived on fishing, pearling and trade with India and Persia.

checkpoints.name: The Trucial States
checkpoints.note: Treaties with Britain from 1820 ended raids at sea and made the sheikhdoms British protectorates. Oil was found in Abu Dhabi in 1958.

checkpoints.name: The union
checkpoints.note: Six emirates united in 1971 under Sheikh Zayed and Ras al-Khaimah joined in 1972. Oil money built Dubai and Abu Dhabi into global cities.
